name: Quick fix — Haiku works, Sonnet verifies, Haiku fixes
description: Lightweight 3-node workflow for bounded tasks: a cheap model does the work, a mid-tier model reviews once, and if rejected the cheap model fixes the issues. No second reviewer, no ship ceremony. Use for rebases, typo fixes, config changes, lockfile updates — anything where the task is obvious and one review pass is enough. Params: task (what to do), cwd (working directory).

params.prompt:
You are completing a quick task in this directory.

=== TASK ===
{{params.task}}

Complete the task now. Be precise and minimal — do exactly what's asked, nothing more. When done, reply with a short summary of what you changed.

meta.description: Worker — Haiku, cheap and fast. Does the bounded task.

params.prompt:
You are verifying a quick fix. Another agent just completed this task:

=== TASK ===
{{params.task}}

=== WHAT WAS DONE ===
{{nodes.work.result.reply}}

Check the actual files in this directory. Verify the work is correct and complete. Run tsc --noEmit if TypeScript files were changed.

Reply with APPROVE if correct, or REJECT with specific problems.

meta.description: Verifier — Sonnet, one review pass. Sanity check, not adversarial.

params.prompt:
A reviewer checked your work:

=== REVIEW ===
{{nodes.verify.result.reply}}

If the reviewer APPROVED, leave everything as-is and reply 'No changes needed.' Otherwise, address every issue raised. Reply with what you fixed.

meta.description: Fix — Haiku, resumes the worker's session. Addresses review feedback if any.

params.prompt:
Ship your work:
1. Check what you changed: git status --short
2. Land it — the ONLY approved path:
   bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/agentruntime/scripts/ship-guard.sh -m 'conventional message' <each changed path>
   It refuses to push main/master, refuses to ship from the shared main checkout, and takes explicit paths only (there is no -A — a shared-index sweep steals other agents' in-flight work). If it REFUSES, STOP and report its message verbatim; do not route around it with raw git.
3. If a PR already exists for this branch, just push. If not, open one: gh pr create --fill --base main

Reply with the PR URL or 'pushed to existing PR'. If nothing changed, reply: NO-CHANGES.

meta.description: Ship — Haiku, resumes session. Commits + pushes.
